_comment: Name and address corrections for the Dropbox document import.
Dropbox folder names are the historical record and Housify is the current one,
so they disagree in ways no algorithm should resolve on its own: a tenant who
married and changed surname, a joint lease filed under one name, a typo that
has been on disk for years, a tenant who moved units. Each entry here is a
human decision, confirmed by Sahil -- never a guess the matcher made.

tenantAliases.note: Same person, name changed. Same property (6958 Hawthorne St). Confirmed 2026-09-15.

_filingRules: Where a lease folder sits under a different property than the tenant's
Housify record, the folder is NOT automatically authoritative -- Sahil
ruled on each one, and the three rulings went three different ways.
